## Summary

The memo's derived metadata lives in two related pieces: a persisted **`Payload`** (tags + boolean properties + title) computed at write time, and a transient **`Snippet`** computed at read/convert time. Both are derived by a single markdown extraction service using goldmark AST walking.

### 1. WHERE the derived metadata is computed

**Persisted properties (`Payload.Property` + `Payload.Tags`):**
- Orchestration: `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` — function `RebuildMemoPayload` (lines 74-88). It calls `markdownService.ExtractAll(...)` and assigns `memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property = data.Property`.
- Actual extraction logic: `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go` — method `(s *service) ExtractAll` (lines 356-422). This is the single-pass AST walk that fills in the `MemoPayload_Property`. (An equivalent, separately-callable `ExtractProperties` exists at lines 193-241.)

**Transient snippet / preview text:**
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` line 76-80 calls `s.getMemoContentSnippet(memo.Content)` and sets `memoMessage.Snippet`.
- `getMemoContentSnippet` is defined at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` lines 83-90, which delegates to `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)`.
- `GenerateSnippet` implementation: `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go` lines 264-346.

### 2. WHICH operations trigger recomputation

`RebuildMemoPayload` is invoked at three call sites (all in `/bench/repo/server`):

- **Create memo** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` line 108 (inside `CreateMemo`), always run on the new content.
- **Update memo** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` line 447 (inside `UpdateMemo`), run only when the `content` field is in the update mask (`path == "content"`, lines 436-451). Non-content updates (visibility, pinned, state) do not recompute.
- **Bulk/migration rebuild** — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` line 52 (`RunOnce`), which re-derives payloads for all memos in batches of 100 and persists them via `Store.UpdateMemo`.

The **snippet** is recomputed on every read/serialization of a memo (each time `convertMemoFromStore` runs in the converter), not persisted.

### 3. WHAT the computation extracts

From `ExtractAll` / `ExtractProperties` in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`, populating `storepb.MemoPayload_Property` (struct defined at `/bench/repo/proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go` lines 85-92):

- `Title` (string) — text of the first block if it is an H1 heading (lines 384-389 / 208-213).
- `HasLink` (bool) — set on `gast.KindLink` (line 394).
- `HasCode` (bool) — set on `KindCodeBlock`, `KindFencedCodeBlock`, or `KindCodeSpan` (line 396).
- `HasTaskList` (bool) — set on `east.KindTaskCheckBox` (line 400).
- `HasIncompleteTasks` (bool) — set when a task checkbox is unchecked (`!checkBox.IsChecked`, lines 401-404).

`ExtractAll` additionally collects, on the same AST walk:
- `Tags` — `#tag` nodes (deduplicated, case preserved), stored into `Payload.Tags`.
- `Mentions` — `@username` nodes, lowercased/deduplicated (collected but not written into the persisted payload by `RebuildMemoPayload`).

The **snippet** (`GenerateSnippet`, lines 264-346) produces a plain-text summary capped at 64 characters: it walks the AST extracting text from paragraphs/headings/list items/table cells, skips fenced/indented code blocks, inlines autolink URLs and `#tags`, adds spacing between block elements, and truncates at a word boundary (`truncateAtWord`, lines 472-489) appending `" ..."`.

switch n.Kind() {
case gast.KindLink:

case east.KindTaskCheckBox:

    if checkBox, ok := n.(*east.TaskCheckBox); ok {

h14.

**Computation site**

The derived metadata lives on `memo.Payload` and is computed by `RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which delegates the actual extraction to the markdown service's `ExtractAll` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:356`):

```go
// server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
...
memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
```

`ExtractAll` does a single AST walk over the parsed markdown and fills a `storepb.MemoPayload_Property` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:371-408`).

**Triggers (recomputation)**

- **Create** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, on `CreateMemo`.
- **Update** — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, in `UpdateMemo` when the `content` field is being changed (guarded by `path == "content"`; it also updates `update.Payload`).
- **Bulk backfill** — `Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72`) rebuilds the payload for all memos in batches of 100, re-persisting via `UpdateMemo`.

**Extracted properties**

- `getMemoContentSnippet` is defined at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` lines 83-90, which delegates to `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)`.
- `GenerateSnippet` implementation: `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go` lines 264-346.

### 2. WHICH operations trigger recomputation

`RebuildMemoPayload` is invoked at three call sites (all in `/bench/repo/server`):

- **Create memo** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` line 108 (inside `CreateMemo`), always run on the new content.
- **Update memo** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` line 447 (inside `UpdateMemo`), run only when the `content` field is in the update mask (`path == "content"`, lines 436-451). Non-content updates (visibility, pinned, state) do not recompute.
- **Bulk/migration rebuild** — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` line 52 (`RunOnce`), which re-derives payloads for all memos in batches of 100 and persists them via `Store.UpdateMemo`.

The **snippet** is recomputed on every read/serialization of a memo (each time `convertMemoFromStore` runs in the converter), not persisted.

### 3. WHAT the computation extracts

From `ExtractAll` / `ExtractProperties` in `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`, populating `storepb.MemoPayload_Property` (struct defined at `/bench/repo/proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go` lines 85-92):
